_doc: A2.9/A2.9a: diario de Dex, capítulo 5 tal como es HOY (de la autorización de Satoshi al epílogo). Se reescribe en A3.7. Ver qa/README.md § Diario.

goals.text: Find out who Patient Zero is.

notes.text: The monitor showed my own transactions. Every mint. Every mistake. Patient Zero... is me?
Took Adrian's handwritten note from the treatment room.

hints: The doctor said yes. The door didn't.
Two locks. You have a key from Adrian's office.
Bring the trading terminal key. Use the treatment door.
One chair. One screen. Sit with it.
The monitor wants to be used, not looked at.
You found what you came for. Now leave.

anonIdle: Go outside. Look at the sky. Just the sky.
